name: browser
description: The browser: open <site> / search <words> open pages, page says what is in front, find gives what Wikipedia and the news say, news the headlines, tabs and close the open tabs, read gives a page's text.

config.description: browser= the app that opens pages
config.template:
# browser: the app that opens pages, Safari or Google Chrome; empty = your default browser
browser=

notes: `page` makes macOS ask to let Amie control the browser (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation). `read` fetches the page itself, so it sees what a visitor who isn't signed in sees.
